description: Quote and build an EIP-712 Fusion order. Returns `typedData` (sign with eth_signTypedData_v4), the `order` object, `extension`, `quoteId` and `orderHash`. Nothing is signed or submitted. After signing, call trdefi_fusion_submit with the same order, the signature, extension and quote id. This is the gated-liquidity path: the user/agent does not need an Aqua NFT; a 1inch resolver fills the order (best-effort, not guaranteed).

amount.description: Input amount in token base units, as an integer string.

preset.description: Auction preset. Defaults to the quote recommendation.

wallet.description: The address that will sign the Fusion order.

name: trdefi_fusion_prepare
title: Prepare a Fusion order to sign
